record.paper: A tight Erdős-Pósa function for wheel minors

dossier_meta.paper: A tight Erdős-Pósa function for wheel minors
dossier_meta.statement_text: There is a function $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ such that for all integers $r, k \geq 1$, every graph $G$ of treewidth at least $f(r) \cdot k \log(k + 1)$ has $k$ vertex-disjoint subgraphs $G_1, \ldots, G_k$, each of treewidth at least $r$.
dossier_meta.context_text: This is the treewidth-level analogue of Conjecture 1.2: it asserts that $c' = 1$ suffices in Theorem 1.3 of Chekuri and Chuzhoy (at least ignoring the precise dependence on $r$), whereas their proof only gives $c' \geq 1$. The authors note it is implied by Conjecture 1.2 by taking $H$ to be the $r \times r$ grid.
